findings.finding: The prior anonymous Odalisque is inspired by Pradier. It must not be included in exact-artist shortlist completion count.

Île-de-France current catalog omits primary composition/date source links already saved in publication research. Add NMWA S.1963-0002 and Orsay33876 as different-cast composition references; do not copy their dimensions.
Yakshi correctly leaves date/geography/dimensions unknown and does not repeat erroneous Standing Buddha phrase.
Iris and Fugitive Love cast dates remain unknown; Benedictions1955 cast disclosed. Portland is the scan/exhibition venue, not owner.

coverageCaveat: These are grouped evidenced examples from focused searches. No claim is made that every remaining original was exhaustively searched, that all are blocked by login, or that they cannot be obtained later.
